findings.title: Check-then-act race allows double redemption of a coupon
findings.description: exists() and add() are separate awaits, so two concurrent requests both observe alreadyUsed=false and both credit the wallet. Make the redemption atomic: insert with a unique (userId, code) constraint and treat a conflict as 'already used', inside a transaction with the credit.
findings.suggestion: Insert the redemption first under a unique constraint and catch the conflict; do the credit in the same transaction.
